preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.description: Each edge connects nodes u and v where 1 ≤ u, v ≤ N.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N for N, A in [(int(stdin.readline()), [int(x) for x in stdin.readline().split()])])
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly N node values.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(stdout.strip()), int) for stdout in [line.strip() for line in sys.stdout if line.strip().isdigit()])
postconditions.description: Each output is a single integer representing the minimum possible security of the tree.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(stdout.strip()) <= 10**18 for stdout in [line.strip() for line in sys.stdout if line.strip().isdigit()])
postconditions.description: Each output is a non-negative integer representing the sum of L_u for all leaves u, where L_u is the bitwise OR of node values on the path from root to leaf u.

postconditions.expression: all(any(L_u > 0 for u in leaves) for L_u in [compute_L_u(tree, A) for tree, A in parse_input()])
postconditions.description: The tree remains secure after every operation, meaning every leaf u has L_u > 0.

postconditions.expression: all(min_security == min(sum(L_u for u in leaves) for L_u in [compute_L_u(tree, A) for tree, A in parse_input() if all(L_u > 0 for u in leaves)]) for min_security in [int(line.strip()) for line in sys.stdout if line.strip().isdigit()])
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum possible security of the tree after performing zero or more operations, ensuring the tree remains secure.
